title: Equal Tunings
description: Tuning systems built by dividing a period into equal steps.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Equal Tunings
title.body: Equal tuning divides a chosen period into equal logarithmic steps. In xenharmonic music this often means EDOs, but the period can be an octave, a tritave, or another repeating interval.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: The Equal Tunings lab will go here.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: What is equal in an equal tuning?

choices.text: The logarithmic size of each step within the period.
The numerator and denominator of every interval ratio.
The number of notes in every melody.

items.title: Pick a target ratio
